# RudraX Aerospace

> RudraX Aerospace engineers autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems for tactical and strategic operations: defence and offence capabilities, surveillance and vigilance, and advanced data research and development. Tagline: "Securing the Skies. Advancing the Future." The company is preparing for launch; the website is currently informational only.

Key facts:

- Name: RudraX Aerospace
- Website: https://www.rudraxaerospace.com/
- Focus: autonomous UAV systems for tactical and strategic operations
- Areas: mission-critical defence and offence capabilities, surveillance, advanced data R&D
- Status: pre-launch; no products, pricing or contact channels are published yet
- Data: the website collects no personal data, sets no cookies and uses no analytics

- [Home](https://www.rudraxaerospace.com/): company overview and launch announcement
